subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent `tui.deliver` config key to set the default for `openclaw tui --deliver`, or keep delivery as an explicit launch flag?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces, so automation should not choose this product contract unilaterally.

options.title: Approve a narrow config default
options.body: Add a documented `tui.deliver` boolean, keep explicit CLI flags authoritative, and cover current/default/override behavior with focused tests.

options.title: Keep flag-only behavior
options.body: Decline the new config surface and rely on `openclaw tui --deliver`, shell aliases, and current docs now that the adjacent abort hang was fixed separately.

options.title: Choose a different TUI UX
options.body: Prefer an in-TUI setting, default flip, or another delivery model instead of adding an `openclaw.json` key.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow config default
recommendation.body: Add a documented `tui.deliver` boolean, keep explicit CLI flags authoritative, and cover current/default/override behavior with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial TUI and several later TUI/config behavior commits trace to this owner path, making steipete the best available routing candidate for the product/config choice.
